meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞：游智婷／曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 主 賜給我 不動搖的信心
lines.b: Lord, give me faith, give me faith unshakeable

lines.a: 海浪之中 祢伸出大手拉住我
lines.b: In stormy seas, You reached down and took hold of me

lines.a: 求除去我 心中所有的懷疑
lines.b: Lord, come and take, take away all fears and doubts

lines.a: 曠野之中 緊緊跟隨 雲柱火柱
lines.b: Cloud by day, fire by night, I'll follow You

lines.a: 海浪之中 我必不沉落
lines.b: In oceans deep, yet I will not sink

lines.a: 曠野之中 我必不迷路
lines.b: In wilderness, I'll find my way

lines.a: 不退縮也不害怕 不動搖也不放棄
lines.b: Won't retreat and will not fear, won't be shaken, nor give up

lines.a: 因我深信祢應許不改變
lines.b: For I know Your promises never change

lines.a: 困難之中 我仍然讚美
lines.b: In troubled times, I'll give You praise

lines.a: 疑惑之中 我仍然禱告
lines.b: In valleys low, I'll call Your name

lines.a: 行在水面的信心 剛強壯膽地前進
lines.b: Give me faith to walk on waves, I'll step forward, strong and brave

lines.a: 我的神必在前面 為我爭戰
lines.b: For I know that You will go ahead of me

lines.a: 我的禱告 無論求什麼
lines.b: All of my prayers, whatever I ask

lines.a: 只要相信 就必得著
lines.b: If I believe, I will receive

lines.a: 我的禱告 無論求什麼
lines.b: All of my prayers, whatever I ask

lines.a: 只要相信 只要相信
lines.b: I believe it, I believe it

lines.a: 只要相信 就必得著
lines.b: I believe it, I will receive

lines.a: 行在水面的信心 剛強壯膽地前進
lines.b: Give me faith to walk on waves, I'll step forward, strong and brave

lines.a: 我的神必在前面 為我爭戰
lines.b: For I know that You will go ahead of me
